cell_line.evidence: To benchmark and optimize the methods, a series of protein lysates from human MIA PaCa-2 cell line were employed.

In order for an extensive evaluation of the quantitative performances of the developed strategy, we prepared a set of spike-in samples by spiking small, variable levels of DH5α E. coli digest (representing altered proteins) into a large, constant level of human cell Panc-1 cell digest, as shown in Supplementary Figure S5.
